contract.core_conclusion: FedSAM3-Cream lets each heterogeneous client optimize only its modality-compatible parameter groups, then performs group-wise aggregation without treating missing updates as eligible uploads.

panel_map.a: Three private modality settings receive the same server round state and a detached public proxy, optimize only their local objectives, and emit optimizer-scoped parameter deltas.
panel_map.b: The server aggregates each parameter group over the compatible uploader set while retaining the unrestricted denominator rule as the controlled alternative.
panel_map.c: Routing policy and the local FedProx objective form a controlled two-by-two study.

contract.evidence_boundary: The figure contains abstract document, MRI, module, and parameter-group icons only. It contains no patient imagery, prediction masks, performance values, or experimental outcomes.
contract.reviewer_risk: The figure must not imply that the detached proxy routes parameters, that clients share identical optimization scopes, that persistent buffers are uploaded, or that all parameter groups use the same eligible client set.
